---
title: "Variable Metadata for `r params$var$FullName`"
output: html_document
params:
  var: NULL
---


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
var <- params$var
```

---
```{r results='asis', echo=FALSE}

cols <- setdiff(colnames(var), "FullName")

for(col in cols){

  cat("# ", col, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(as.character(var[[col]]), "\n\n")
}
